scope: Read-only revised V8 diagnostic controller/worksheet check; no execution or repo changes. Preserves v1 review.
fixes_confirmed: Owner child environment removes inherited RC_* and GIT_* and explicitly sets no lazy fetch, no replacement objects and no terminal prompts.

After child completes/reaps, snapshot exceptions, unreadable/nonregular or malformed report, invalid report shape/scope and log read/type failures are recorded as receipt fields. Readable output receives path/hash/size before JSON parse; malformed output does not become owner_report pass.

Snapshot rows now include tracked file permission modes. Worksheet and receipt explicitly limit proof to tracked regular-file bytes, size, mode and HEADs, excluding ignored/untracked inputs, Git internals and external runtime.
Pinned Node, fresh paths, 180-second process-group timeout and 1800-second separate original qualification distinction remain.
remaining_caveat: After writing the truthful receipt, the script asserts only source_unchanged. A malformed output or log error with unchanged source still returns process exit 0; a shell consumer could misread this as successful diagnostic collection. Prefer nonzero after receipt for report/log collection errors while distinguishing expected timeout (which normally has no report). Cross-check owner report against child returncode/timed_out if classifying successful diagnostic.
other_limits: Prelaunch snapshot or Popen failures still precede the receipt, and external interruption or unexpected communicate error has no top-level group cleanup finally. These cases are outside the specific post-child fix, not evidence a diagnostic ran.

Post-worksheet commit HEAD/source-gate binding remains a launch-time external check. Snapshot is not a full source/peer/Git environment qualification and profiler success is not full owner qualification.
